book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesun seebu ɡɔrin di
Tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡirun biru, ɑlusumɑ buu sɔ̃nu buru buru yellu, Mɑɑri Mɑdɑlɑɡii kɑ Mɑɑri wiɔnɔ bɑ siki te tendem dɑ.
Suɑru sɔɔ tem yĩiri bɑkɑbu seewɑ, mɑ Yinnin ɡɔrɑdo u sɑrɑmɑ wɔllun di u nɑ u kpee te bɔriɑ u sinɑri.
Win wuswɑɑ bɑllimɔ nɡe ɡuru mɑɑkinu mɑ win yɑ̃nu buriri nɡe suru.
Bɛrum bɑkɑm mu kɔ̃so be mwɑ bɑ diirɑ mɑ bɑ kuɑ nɡe ɡonu.
Gɔrɑdo wi, u kurɔ be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ku bɛrum ko bɛɛ! Nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ Yesuwɑ i kɑsu, wi bɑ kpɑre dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑrɔ.
U ǹ wɑ̃ɑ mini, u seewɑ nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ. I nɑ i wɑ mi u rɑɑ kpĩ,
kpɑ i dɑ fuuku fuuku i win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ mɑ u seewɑ ɡɔrin di. Wee, u bɛɛ ɡbiiyɔ u dɔɔ Gɑlileɔ. Miyɑ i ko nùn wɑ. Yerɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔbu nɑ.
Bɑ ɡɔsirɑ kpɑɑkɑ sikiru min di kɑ bɛrum kɑ nuku doo bɑkɑbu, bɑ duki dɑ bu bwɑ̃ɑ be lɑbɑɑri ye sɔ̃.
Wee Yesu kɑ bu yinnɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ bɛɛ tɔburɑ. Mɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ win nɑɑsu nɛnuɑ bɑ nùn sɑ̃wɑ.
Yerɑ Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ku bɛrum ko, i doo i nɛɡibu sɔ̃ bu doo Gɑlileɔ. Miyɑ bɑ koo mɑn wɑ.
Kɔ̃so ben ɡɑri
Nɡe mɛ bɑ dɔɔ, kɔ̃so ben ɡɑbɑ duɑ wuu sɔɔ bɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye n koorɑ kpuro.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero be, bɑ mɛnnɑ kɑ ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ wesiɑnɑ mɑ bɑ tɑbu kowobu ɡobi bɛkɛ kɑ̃.
Bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, i ɡeruo mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ bɑ nɑ wɔ̃kuru bɑ win ɡoru ɡbɛnɑ sɑnɑm mɛ i do.
Tem yɛ̃ro ù n ɡɑri yi nuɑ sɑ yɛ̃ mɛ sɑ ko nùn kuɑ su kɑ bɛɛ yɑrɑ wɑhɑlɑn di.
Tɑbu kowo be, bɑ ɡobi yi mwɑ mɑ bɑ kuɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ bu yiire. Yeyɑ n derɑ Yuubɑ bɑ rɑ n ɡɑri yi ɡerumɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu tii sɔ̃ɔsi
Bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ tiɑ ye, yɑ dɑ Gɑlileɔ ɡuu ten mi, te Yesu rɑɑ bu yĩreru kuɑ.
Ye bɑ nùn wɑ, bɑ nùn sɑ̃wɑ. Adɑmɑ ben ɡɑbɑ ɡɔ̃rusu yiru mɔ̀.
Yesu bu susi u nɛɛ, wɔllu kɑ tem yiiko kpurowɑ bɑ mɑn wɛ̃.
Yen sɔ̃, i doo bwesenu kpuron mi, kpɑ i bu ko nɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu. I bu bɑtɛmu koowo kɑ Bɑɑn yĩsiru kɑ Biiɡiru kɑ Hunde Dɛɛroɡiru.
Kpɑ i de ye nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ n ye kpuro mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ. N wee, ko nɑ n kɑ bɛɛ wɑ̃ɑ bɑɑdommɑ sere kɑ hɑnduniɑn kpeerɔ.
